description: Fetch (or read from cache) a connector's OpenAPI definition and list its operations with operationId, parameters (required, type, description) and response fields; marks MCP-capable connectors (x-ms-agentic-protocol). Exactly what cs_add_tool needs. Cached under .cs-catalog/<environment>/connectors/<name>.json and used by cs_validate.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

operation.description: Filter operations by id or summary

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_describe_connector
title: Describe a connector's operations
